title: Schema for COVID-19 Forecast Hub Archive model metadata
description: Schema for model metadata files in the COVID-19 Forecast Hub archive. Adapted from the legacy covid19-forecast-hub schema.yml plus modern hubverse conventions. See https://docs.hubverse.io for details.

team_name.description: The name of the team submitting the model

team_abbr.description: Abbreviated name of the team submitting the model

license.description: License governing the model output data

citation.description: One or more citations for this model

team_funding.description: Funding sources for the team or its members

twitter_handles.description: Twitter/X handles for the team or its members

team_model_designation.description: Submission designation per the legacy hub

data_inputs.description: List or description of data inputs used by the model

methods.description: A brief (<= 200 char) description of the model's methods

methods_long.description: A full description of the model's methods

ensemble_of_hub_models.description: TRUE if the model is an ensemble of other hub models

this_model_is_an_ensemble.description: Legacy alias for ensemble_of_hub_models — kept for fidelity
